description: Original pinned PULP apb_gpio, 32 pads, APB3 full-word MMIO. Pulse interrupt exported for observation; not connected to the first-phase level controller.

resets.release: RTL asynchronously asserts active-low reset; release must satisfy HCLK recovery/removal timing.

port_actions.reason: DFT disabled in this functional scenario. At the pinned revision this input is declared but unused; sampling enables are computed from r_gpio_en, not this input.
Active-high s_rise_int pulse from synchronized GPIO transitions. This is not the held r_status bitmap; observe without pulse-to-level conversion.

semantics: Source rtl/apb_gpio.sv at the pinned revision: register defines, s_apb_addr=PADDR[6:2], and APB write/read case statements establish the offsets. PAD_NUM=32 selects the lower bank; upper-bank reads are zero and writes have no pad effect.
r_status accumulates s_is_int_all; a read of INTSTATUS 0x24 clears the lower bank only when no concurrent s_rise_int is present (new events take priority). Reading PADIN does not clear status.
interrupt=s_rise_int, not OR(r_status). GPIOEN and INTEN gate falling/rising/both-edge pulse generation according to INTTYPE. A cleared status does not define pulse width.
PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=0. Unimplemented offsets read zero; ignored address bits cause aliases. There is no PSTRB, so only full-word writes are admitted by the generic APB3 adapter.
All state blocks use HCLK and negedge HRESETn; GPIO sampling is enabled in groups of four using GPIOEN. dft_cg_enable_i has no internal use.
unknown: Pulse IRQ is intentionally not attached to the first-phase level-only interrupt controller: CPU interrupt servicing of this peripheral is not covered.

The generator rejects an honestly declared edge trigger for its level-only controller. A profile falsely claiming a held level must be caught by independent semantic/source review; physical elaboration alone cannot prove that claim.
Only PAD_NUM=32/NBIT_PADCFG=4/APB_ADDR_WIDTH=12 is exercised by this profile acceptance; other parameterizations are not claimed verified.
Pad electrical behaviour and an external pin driver are not provided by structural generation; all pins are exported.
